evals.prompt: Bug report: after Queue.remove(id) on a completed job, waitUntilFinished() for that id still resolves with the old result over TCP. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes a regression test first (test/repro-*.test.ts over the real TCP path), runs it, shows it failing on the assertion about the returned result, then delegates the fix to subagents, proves the test passes with neighbouring tests, updates docs and the changelog [Unreleased] Bug fixes section, runs or schedules bun run test:sandbox, and asks the skeptic before any commit; it does not commit without an explicit request.
assertions: A reproducing test is written before any runtime source file is edited
The test is run and its failure output is shown or quoted before the fix
The failure is checked to be for the right reason (the bug's assertion, not a setup error)
Subagents are used to investigate or implement the fix
The changelog [Unreleased] section and the relevant docs/features page are updated in the same change
The skeptic is invoked on the staged diff before any commit, and no commit happens without the user's request

evals.prompt: The skeptic returned FAIL on my staged fix: it says the new SIGHUP handler changes behavior for servers started under nohup. What now?
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the concern as real, reproduces it with a test (a server under nohup receiving SIGHUP), decides the compatible behavior, fixes or documents it as an Upgrade note, reruns affected tests and the gate if code changed, and re-invokes the skeptic with a 'fixed since last round' list until PASS.
assertions: The concern is answered with a test or a code change, not an argument
Affected tests are rerun, and the sandbox gate is rerun when code changed
The skeptic is invoked again with the fixes listed
A remaining CONDITIONAL item is put to the user for explicit confirmation rather than committed

evals.prompt: My new regression test reads test-fixtures.json from the repo root. It passes with bun test locally but the sandbox unit container fails with ENOENT. Fix the test setup.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that the test image only contains files allow-listed in Dockerfile.test.dockerignore and copied by Dockerfile.test, adds the file to both (or moves the fixture under test/), reruns the focused test and the sandbox gate, and records the change in the changelog.
assertions: Both Dockerfile.test (COPY) and Dockerfile.test.dockerignore (allow-list) are updated, or the fixture moves under test/
The agent does not weaken or skip the test to make it pass
bun run test:sandbox is rerun to prove the fix in the container
